title: Deepgram buys Pipecat maker Daily and keeps the voice AI framework open
content:
Voice AI company Deepgram is buying Daily, the maker of Pipecat, an open-source framework for building voice agents. Pipecat will stay open source and free under its existing BSD V2 licence. The companies are also setting up an independent Pipecat Foundation.
Deepgram announced the deal on Thursday in a blog post, on the day of Deepgram Speak, its first conference, in San Francisco. Daily co-founder Kwindla Hultman Kramer set out the details in a post of his own. Neither company disclosed the price of the Deepgram Daily acquisition, Ivan Mehta reported for TechCrunch.
“Keeping Pipecat open was fundamental to our decision to join Deepgram,” Kramer said in the announcement.
What Deepgram is buying
Pipecat links the parts of a voice agent: speech-to-text, a large language model and text-to-speech. It also handles the voice and video streams between them while keeping delays low. Kramer wrote that it has more than 200 integrations and almost 400 contributors, and that 18 engineers built it.
Daily runs hosted infrastructure for real-time voice and video on a network of 75 points of presence, according to Deepgram. Daily has raised more than $62m from investors including Tiger Global, Nat Friedman and Lachy Groom, TechCrunch reported, citing PitchBook data.
Deepgram says more than 5,000 organisations run its speech models in production. It raised a $130m Series C in January that made it a unicorn, according to TechCrunch. Both companies went through Y Combinator in 2016, and Deepgram has powered transcription inside Daily’s products since 2019, Kramer wrote.
A foundation for Pipecat
The Daily team will join Deepgram, and Kramer becomes its head of open source. Deepgram will sell, support and develop all of Daily’s current products, he wrote. It is also making Pipecat the core of its new voice AI products.
“For Daily’s customers and the Pipecat ecosystem, nothing will change,” Kramer wrote.
A steering committee will manage the foundation, and it will include companies that compete with Deepgram, according to Kramer. He told TechCrunch that several companies had shown interest in buying Daily. He chose Deepgram because chief executive Scott Stephenson committed to keeping Pipecat open source.
“Scott was super committed to Pipecat being open source and vendor-neutral forever,” Kramer told TechCrunch.
Stephenson told TechCrunch that Deepgram had wanted to work in open source for a long time. He said developers should be free to pick models from other companies.
“It’s great if you’re using Deepgram models, but I want you to be using the best models for your use case,” Stephenson said.
A standard for what voice agents hear
At Speak, Stephenson is also introducing the Real-Time Context Standard (RCS), an open protocol built with the Pipecat team. Deepgram says voice systems today pass words from one model to the next. What gets lost is the audio around them, such as tone, who is speaking and background noise.
RCS adds three kinds of metadata. The first is signals from the audio, such as a whisper or an unclear word. The others are instructions for how a language model should use them, and guidance on how the reply should sound. Deepgram says that lets an agent ask again when it did not hear clearly, or answer quietly when someone whispers.
Chief product officer Ed Anuff is due to preview the Deepgram Voice Agent Platform, built on Deepgram’s models and Pipecat, later on Thursday. He will also introduce two new models for live conversation, the company says.
Voice AI has drawn large investments this year from both model makers and infrastructure companies, TechCrunch noted. TNW has covered Vapi’s Series B, Fish Audio’s seed round and talks over an ElevenLabs tender offer.

report.summary: Deepgram收购Daily，Pipecat保持开源并设基金会
report.background: 语音AI正成为今年投资热点，模型层和基础设施层都在加速整合。Deepgram是语音识别与语音模型公司，2016年与Daily同批进入Y Combinator，今年1月完成1.3亿美元C轮并成为独角兽，已有5000多家组织在生产环境使用其模型。Daily提供实时语音视频基础设施，并孵化了开源语音Agent框架Pipecat，双方自2019年起已有转录合作。此次收购把实时传输、开源编排框架和语音模型进一步捆在一起，但交易价格未披露。
key_points: Deepgram收购Daily，Daily团队并入，Pipecat联合创始人Kramer出任Deepgram开源负责人，Daily现有产品由Deepgram继续销售和支持。
Pipecat是连接语音识别、大模型和语音合成的开源框架，负责低延迟音视频流，已有200多个集成、近400名贡献者和18名工程师参与建设。
Pipecat将继续以BSD V2许可证免费开源，并设立独立基金会，由包含Deepgram竞争对手在内的指导委员会治理，强调厂商中立。
Deepgram发布实时上下文标准RCS，在语音转文字之外传递语气、说话人、背景噪声等元数据，让语音Agent能追问或轻声回应。
Deepgram还将预览基于自家模型和Pipecat的Voice Agent Platform，并推出两个面向实时对话的新模型，推动Pipecat成为其语音AI产品核心。
report.impact: 对AI行业，语音Agent栈出现“模型+实时传输+开源编排”的整合样本，但基金会治理能否保持中立是关键。对开发者，Pipecat仍可免费使用，短期迁移风险低，但需关注路线图是否受Deepgram商业目标影响。对普通用户，语音助手有望更低延迟、更懂语气和场景，交互更自然。
report.tools: 可关注Pipecat开源框架、Deepgram语音API、Daily实时音视频基础设施，以及RCS规范和Deepgram Voice Agent Platform。想上手可先用Pipecat串联STT、LLM和TTS搭建原型。
